proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for baseimage-kasmvnc, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the baseimage-kasmvnc service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the baseimage-kasmvnc
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  baseimage-kasmvnc:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.baseimage-kasmvnc.loadbalancer.server.port=3000
      - traefik.http.routers.baseimage-kasmvnc.rule=Host(`baseimage-kasmvnc.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.baseimage-kasmvnc.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.baseimage-kasmvnc.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.baseimage-kasmvnc.service=baseimage-kasmvnc
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.baseimage-kasmvnc.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.baseimage-kasmvnc.middlewares=authentik@docker

kubernetes:
# Baseimage-kasmvnc: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-baseimage-kasmvnc/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: baseimage-kasmvnc-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: baseimage-kasmvnc
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: baseimage-kasmvnc
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: baseimage-kasmvnc
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: baseimage-kasmvnc
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: baseimage-kasmvnc
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: baseimage-kasmvnc
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-kasmvnc:alpine321
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: baseimage-kasmvnc-env
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
quadlet:
# baseimage-kasmvnc.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-baseimage-kasmvnc/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Baseimage-kasmvnc (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-kasmvnc:alpine321
ContainerName=baseimage-kasmvnc
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
